title: Difference-in-differences with two-way fixed effects (single adoption date)
summary: The effect of a policy adopted by some units at one time, from unit and period fixed effects, with a standard error clustered on the adopting unit.

sizing._why: Sizing a DiD needs the number of units, periods, the within-unit correlation and the pre-period variance; no catalog form takes them. Simulation.

pinned_defaults: Both: unit (hospital) and period (quarter) fixed effects; the coefficient on the policy indicator.
Both: SE clustered on hospital, HC1 (sandwich::vcovCL type = 'HC1'; statsmodels' cluster covariance applies the same factor).
Scope: ONE adoption date. With staggered adoption and time-varying effects TWFE can be badly biased (Goodman-Bacon 2021); use a heterogeneity-robust estimator (Callaway-Sant'Anna).
_parallel_trends: The DiD is causal only if the groups would have moved in parallel without the policy. Plot the pre-period group means or fit an event study before relying on it; the fixture satisfies it by construction.
